auth.enterEmailForReset: Enter the email on your account.

arrivoExpress.title: ArrivoExpress
arrivoExpress.tagline: On-demand rides, priced by distance and time. Pick a vehicle, see your fare, and we'll match you with a nearby driver.
arrivoExpress.unavailableBody: ArrivoExpress isn't switched on for your account yet. Try Book a Ride or On the Go instead, or check back soon.
arrivoExpress.networkError: Couldn't reach RideArrivo. Check your connection and try again.
arrivoExpress.selectPickupError: Select your pickup address from the suggestions.
arrivoExpress.selectDestinationError: Select your destination from the suggestions.
arrivoExpress.fareError: Couldn't get a fare for that trip. Please try again.
arrivoExpress.bookError: Couldn't book this ride. Please try again.
arrivoExpress.insufficientWalletBody: Top up your RideArrivo Wallet to book this ArrivoExpress ride.
arrivoExpress.cantCancelBody: Please try again in a moment.
arrivoExpress.expiredBody: We couldn't match you with a driver before your request expired. Any wallet charge has been refunded.
arrivoExpress.walletChargeNote: Charged to your RideArrivo Wallet on confirmation.
arrivoExpress.homeBannerSubtitle: On-demand rides, priced by distance, matched in minutes.

pin.title: Your pickup PIN
pin.help: Tell your driver this PIN when you meet. They need it to start the trip. Do not share it before you are with your driver.

share.stopped: Sharing stopped. Links you sent no longer work.
share.note: Share links stop working a few hours after pickup, or soon after the trip ends. You can stop sharing at any time.
share.failed: Could not stop sharing. Please try again.

report.title: Report a problem
report.help: Tell us what happened. The driver will not see your report. If you are in danger, use the panic button.
report.sent: Thank you. We received your report and will look into it.
report.failed: Could not send your report. Please try again.

cat.vehicle_mismatch: Car or plate did not match the app

call.freeSub: Free, in the app. Your number stays private.
call.supportDone: Support has your ride and what happened. They'll reach you in the app shortly.
call.supportOpening: We couldn't open a ticket from here. Opening the RideArrivo support chat.
call.supportFailed: We couldn't reach support from here. Please open Support in the menu.
call.a11yCall: Call {{who}} in the app. No phone numbers are shared.

no_answer.title: {{who}} didn't pick up
no_answer.body: They may be driving or have no signal. Try again, or send a message.

declined.title: {{who}} can't talk right now
declined.body: Send a message instead, and they'll see it straight away.

dropped.title: The call dropped
dropped.body: The connection was lost. Try again, or message them.

network.title: No connection
network.body: Check your data or Wi-Fi, then try again.

rate_limited.title: Lots of calls in a short time
rate_limited.body: Give it a few minutes, or message them instead.

calling_unavailable.title: Calling isn't available right now
calling_unavailable.body: We're on it. Message them in the app, or talk to support.

call_failed.title: We couldn't connect the call
call_failed.body: Nothing you did. Try again, or message them.

no_driver.title: Calling opens soon
no_driver.body: You can call as soon as a driver accepts this ride.

not_active.title: Calling opens soon
not_active.body: You can call once the driver has accepted the ride.

cancelled.title: This ride was cancelled
cancelled.body: Calls are only for active trips.

trip_over.title: This trip is over
trip_over.body: For anything about it, talk to support.

incoming_call.title: They're calling you right now
incoming_call.body: Answer the call on your screen. If you can't see it, open the app again.

already_in_call.title: You're already on a call
already_in_call.body: Finish or end the current call first.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: Try again, or message them. Support is here if you need us.

phoneRequired.title: Add your phone number to book
phoneRequired.body: Your driver and our team need a way to reach you about this trip. We'll save it to your profile, so we only ask once.
phoneRequired.failed: Couldn't save your number. Please try again.
